note: The tallies of the last complete golden run (tier A and tier B), as the runner reported them. Regenerated from the runner report after every full run; the README prints from this file and the Evaluation surface publishes the same run with its per-case failures.
skipped_reason: the case carries a setup the runner cannot satisfy (a published draft, an injected string, an outbound draft); GS-72 is hard-gated, so one gate is unproved rather than failed

not_evaluated.reason: the check's arguments reach outside the ask lane (the corpus, the packages, the rule-pack port, a draft, the export or the coverage console); counted as neither pass nor fail
